SELECT s.consignor_org_id as consignorOrgId, s.consignor_org_name as consignorOrgName, ifnull(sum(s.new_survey_case_num),0) as newSurveyCaseNum, ifnull(sum(s.new_check_num),0) as newCheckNum, ifnull(sum(s.survey_money),0) as surveyMoney, ifnull(sum(s.survey_billing),0) as surveyBilling, ifnull(sum(s.survey_account),0) as surveyAccount, ifnull(avg(s.average),0) as average, ifnull(avg(s.positive_rate),0) as positiveRate, ifnull(avg(s.regional),0) as regional, ifnull(avg(s.efficiency),0) as efficiency, ifnull(avg(s.loss_efficiency_rate),0) as lossEfficiencyRate, ifnull(sum(s.direction_num),0) as directionNum FROM survey_consignor_report s WHERE 1 = 1
GROUP BY s.consignor_org_id
order by sum(s.new_check_num) desc
order by sum(s.new_survey_case_num) asc
order by sum(s.new_survey_case_num) desc
order by sum(s.new_check_num) asc
order by sum(s.new_check_num) desc
order by sum(s.survey_money) asc
order by sum(s.survey_money) desc
order by sum(s.survey_money)/sum(s.new_check_num) asc
order by sum(s.survey_money)/sum(s.new_check_num) desc
order by avg(s.positive_rate) asc
order by avg(s.positive_rate) desc
order by avg(s.regional) asc
order by avg(s.regional) desc
order by avg(s.efficiency) asc
order by avg(s.efficiency) desc
order by avg(s.loss_efficiency_rate) asc
order by avg(s.loss_efficiency_rate) desc
order by (ifnull(sum(s.survey_money),0) / ifnull(sum(s.direction_num),1) ) asc
order by (ifnull(sum(s.survey_money),0) / ifnull(sum(s.direction_num),1) ) desc

select n.id consignorOrgId,n.name consignorOrgName,ifnull(a.num,0) newSurveyCaseNum,ifnull(aa.num,0) as momNewSurveyCaseNum,ifnull(b.num,0) newCheckNum,ifnull(c.money,0) surveyMoney, ifnull(d.num,0) directionNum,ifnull(e.num,0) sunNum,ifnull(f.num,0) regional,ifnull(g.num,0) efficiency,ifnull(h.num,0) lossNum, ifnull(aa.num,0) hbNewSurveyCaseNum,ifnull(tb.num,0) tbNewSurveyCaseNum,k.num orgCommitNum from survey_consignor n left join ( select r.entrust_org_id,ifnull(count(1),0) num from survey_risk_case_info r left join survey_risk_case c on r.survey_id = c.id left join survey_consignor n on r.entrust_org_id = n.id where r.delete_flag = 0
AND date_format(c.entrust_time,'%Y-%m-%d') >= date_format(#{startTime,jdbcType=DATE},'%Y-%m-%d')
AND date_format(c.entrust_time,'%Y-%m-%d') <= date_format(#{endTime,jdbcType=DATE},'%Y-%m-%d')
group by r.entrust_org_id )a on a.entrust_org_id = n.id left join ( select r.entrust_org_id,ifnull(count(1),0) num from survey_risk_case_info r left join survey_risk_case c on r.survey_id = c.id left join survey_consignor n on r.entrust_org_id = n.id where r.delete_flag = 0
AND date_format(c.entrust_time,'%Y-%m-%d') >= date_format(#{momTime,jdbcType=DATE},'%Y-%m-%d')
AND date_format(c.entrust_time,'%Y-%m-%d') < date_format(#{startTime,jdbcType=DATE},'%Y-%m-%d')
group by r.entrust_org_id )aa on aa.entrust_org_id = n.id left join ( select r.entrust_org_id,ifnull(count(1),0) num from survey_risk_case_info r left join survey_risk_case c on r.survey_id = c.id left join survey_consignor n on r.entrust_org_id = n.id where r.delete_flag = 0
AND date_format(c.entrust_time,'%Y-%m-%d') >= date_format(#{tbStartTime,jdbcType=DATE},'%Y-%m-%d')
AND date_format(c.entrust_time,'%Y-%m-%d') <= date_format(#{tbEndTime,jdbcType=DATE},'%Y-%m-%d')
group by r.entrust_org_id )tb on tb.entrust_org_id = n.id left join ( select r.entrust_org_id,ifnull(count(1),0) num from survey_risk_case_info r left join survey_risk_case c on r.survey_id = c.id left join survey_consignor n on r.entrust_org_id = n.id where r.delete_flag = 0
group by r.entrust_org_id )b on b.entrust_org_id = n.id left join ( select r.entrust_org_id,ifnull(SUM(r.entrust_ok_price_1 + r.entrust_ok_price_2),0) money from survey_risk_case_info r left join survey_risk_case c on r.survey_id = c.id left join survey_consignor n on r.entrust_org_id = n.id where r.delete_flag = 0
group by r.entrust_org_id )c on c.entrust_org_id = n.id left join ( select r.entrust_org_id,ifnull(count(1),0) num from survey_case_direction d left join survey_risk_case_info r on d.survey_info_id = r.id left join survey_risk_case c on r.survey_id = c.id left join survey_consignor n on r.entrust_org_id = n.id where r.delete_flag = 0
group by r.entrust_org_id )d on d.entrust_org_id = n.id left join ( select r.entrust_org_id,ifnull(count(1),0) num from survey_risk_case_info r left join survey_risk_case c on r.survey_id = c.id left join survey_consignor n on r.entrust_org_id = n.id where r.delete_flag = 0
and r.is_sun = 1 group by r.entrust_org_id )e on e.entrust_org_id = n.id left join ( select r.entrust_org_id,round(AVG(t.num),2) num from ( select d.survey_info_id,COUNT(DISTINCT d.province_id) num from survey_case_direction d left join survey_risk_case_info r on d.survey_info_id = r.id left join survey_consignor n on r.entrust_org_id = n.id where d.delete_flag = 0 and r.delete_flag = 0
GROUP BY d.survey_info_id ) t left join survey_risk_case_info r on t.survey_info_id = r.id group by r.entrust_org_id )f on f.entrust_org_id = n.id left join ( select r.entrust_org_id,avg(r.aging_day) as num from survey_risk_case_info r left join survey_consignor n on r.entrust_org_id = n.id where r.delete_flag = 0
group by r.entrust_org_id )g on g.entrust_org_id = n.id left join ( select r.entrust_org_id,ifnull(count(1),0) num from survey_risk_case_info r left join survey_risk_case c on r.survey_id = c.id left join survey_consignor n on r.entrust_org_id = n.id where r.delete_flag = 0
and r.entrust_report_end_date > r.end_time group by r.entrust_org_id )h on h.entrust_org_id = n.id left join ( select r.entrust_org_id,ifnull(count(1),0) num from survey_risk_case_info r left join survey_risk_case c on r.survey_id = c.id left join survey_consignor n on r.entrust_org_id = n.id where r.delete_flag = 0
AND date_format(r.lefan_report_date,'%Y-%m-%d') >= date_format(#{startTime,jdbcType=DATE},'%Y-%m-%d')
AND date_format(r.lefan_report_date,'%Y-%m-%d') <= date_format(#{endTime,jdbcType=DATE},'%Y-%m-%d')
group by r.entrust_org_id )k on k.entrust_org_id = n.id where n.org_attr = #{orgAttr,jdbcType=INTEGER} and n.delete_flag = 0 and n.org_state = 0
and n.id = #{entrustOrgId,jdbcType=BIGINT}
and find_in_set(n.id,#{entrustOrgIds,jdbcType=VARCHAR})
order by b.num desc
order by a.num asc
order by a.num desc
order by b.num asc
order by b.num desc
order by c.money asc
order by c.money desc
order by c.money/b.num asc
order by c.money/b.num desc
order by c.money/d.num asc
order by c.money/d.num desc
order by e.num/b.num asc
order by e.num/b.num desc
order by f.num asc
order by f.num desc
order by g.num asc
order by g.num desc
order by h.num/b.num asc
order by h.num/b.num desc

SELECT s.report_date as reportDate, sum(s.new_survey_case_num) as newSurveyCaseNum, sum(s.new_check_num) as newCheckNum, sum(s.survey_money) as surveyMoney, sum(s.survey_billing) as surveyBilling, sum(s.survey_account) as surveyAccount, sum(s.average) as average, avg(s.positive_rate) as positiveRate, avg(s.regional) as regional, avg(s.efficiency) as efficiency, avg(s.loss_efficiency_rate) as lossEfficiencyRate FROM survey_consignor_report s WHERE 1 = 1
GROUP BY s.report_date

select r.entrust_org_id entrustOrgId,r.id surveyInfoId,r.is_sun isSun,(case when r.entrust_report_end_date > r.end_time then 1 else 0 end) isOver, DATE_FORMAT(r.entrust_report_end_date,'%Y-%m') reportDate from survey_risk_case_info r left join survey_consignor n on r.entrust_org_id = n.id where r.delete_flag = 0

select r.entrust_org_id entrustOrgId,o.survey_org_id surveyOrgId,(case when a.id is null then 0 else 1 end) isSun,(case when b.id is null then 0 else 1 end) isOver, DATE_FORMAT(r.entrust_report_end_date,'%Y-%m') reportDate from survey_assign_org o left join survey_risk_case_info r on o.survey_info_id = r.id left join survey_consignor n on r.entrust_org_id = n.id left join ( select o.id from survey_assign_org o left join survey_investigator_case c on o.id = c.survey_assorg_case_id and c.delete_flag = 0 where o.delete_flag = 0 and c.is_sun = 1 ) a on o.id = a.id left join ( select o.id from survey_assign_org o where o.delete_flag = 0 and o.aging_real > o.aging_check ) b on o.id = b.id where o.delete_flag = 0
and o.survey_org_id = #{surveyOrgIdTrend,jdbcType=BIGINT}

select DATE_FORMAT(r.entrust_report_end_date,'%Y-%m-%d') reportDateStr,ifnull(count(1),0) newCheckNum from survey_risk_case_info r left join survey_risk_case c on r.survey_id = c.id left join survey_consignor n on r.entrust_org_id = n.id where r.delete_flag = 0 and r.entrust_report_end_date is not null
